Can’t sleep? Watch this 👀 - Yang Mun 

#sleep #cantsleep #healthybodyhealthymind #usahealth
transcript: You try to sleep, but your mind won't let you. You're lying there, hour after hour, eyes closed, still awake. You've tried all the tips from the internet. Breathing tricks, counting, music. Nothing really works, because the problem isn't sleep. It's that your mind doesn't know when to turn off. Tonight, I'll show you one thing that feels like a light switch once you try it. Don't fight your thoughts. Instead, tell your brain this. Nothing needs to be solved tonight. Say it slowly, again. Nothing needs to be solved tonight. Then shift your focus out of your head and into your body. Feel the weight of your body pressing into the bed. Slow your exhale, longer out than in. This tells your nervous system it's safe to shut down. Thoughts will still appear. That's okay. The moment you stop engaging them, they lose power. And when the brain stops working, sleep turns on like a switch. If this spoke to you, follow for more quiet guidance like this. And comment, sleep, so I know you're here.
